records.label: paraphrase_limit
records.input: Am I able to send these trainers back? A fortnight has passed since I got them.

result.response: Sorry — I didn't understand that request. This assistant matches fixed phrases and can help with: order status, tracking, returns, refunds, cancellation, product info, warranty. Try rephrasing with an order number, e.g. 'Where is order ref:6510d6f84d72e21c51f9?'

observed_limitations: Paraphrase is unmatched despite an understandable return request.
Multiple-intent request produces only a return-window answer and omits requested tracking.
limits: Fresh deterministic baseline replay with synthetic fixtures, no model calls. Baseline is a comparison component, not the final support runtime. Sanitized inputs and exact input digests are retained.
